PvpListKill.description: `issue_player_award` adds it to a ring of 200 entries (node/server.js:3021). The victor is the character with the `block` of the victim, if any, else the killer. Kills in `duelland` and team kills in `abtesting` return before this line, so they are not in the list (node/server.js:2934-2947).
